d:
New Mexico Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham says prospective 2028 Democratic presidential contenders are already making their presence felt in the state, naming Mark Kelly, Rahm Emanuel, Pete Buttigieg and Cory Booker among those who have been on the ground. New Mexico is set to vote fourth in the Democratic presidential primary calendar. She also discusses permitting reform and the growing data-center buildout with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
More on Bloomberg Television and Markets
